en.sarwar: 307. From him, from Salih, from Muhammad Bin Abdullah, from Abdul Malik Bin Basheer, who has narrated the following:
Abu Al-Hassan the First (a.s.) having said that Al-Hassan (a.s.) was the most similar, of the people, to Musa Bin Imran (as) from what is in between his (a.s.) head to his (a.s.) navel,
and that Al-Husayn (a.s.) was the most similar of the people, to Musa Bin Imran (as) from what is in between his (a.s.) navel to his (a.s.) feet’.
